notes.title: Hello, world (of CUISINE!)
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! 

It's about time we introduced ourselves. My name is Michal and I am responsible for this quite ambitious undertaking that we call Restaurant Simulator.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36218225/0625733b33438999e8b80b47efb36d4f56490e2d.jpg[/img]

By "ambitious" I mean that [u]we want to add something to the genre,[/u] and not just be a part of the crowd. We'll explain in detail what we want to do later on, so follow our page, or even wishlist the game to stay updated.

For now, let me [b]thank you for being here[/b]. Your interest in our project means a lot because this means that you share our passion. During our brainstormings we come up with a lot of ideas for the game that will hopefully make it different and outstanding. If you're here, you can probably see our intentions already, and that's just awesome.

Let me finish here for today. There will still be a lot to talk about. It may take some time to come up with new posts because, well, the development of the game comes first. I'd like these news to be meaningful and informative, so the frequency may not be super high. I hope you agree that it's the better approach.

Oh, and consider wishlisting our game, because at this stage, this kind of support will help us greatly.

[b]See you later![/b]
Michal from LifeSim Games

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1166660/Restaurant_Simulator/

notes.title: Happy New Year!
notes.notes:
Out with the old, in with the new! Happy New Year and let’s hope it brings us all prosperity and good fortune. May it be the best year of your life yet.

notes.title: Happy Holidays!
notes.notes:
For these upcoming holidays, we want to wish you all a time full of joy and peace. 

Much love, happiness, time spent in a family atmosphere with the smell of gingerbread and hot chocolate in the air. Thank you for being with us!
